## Summary

<!-- Up to 10 short bullets (aim for 5 or fewer), one per change (a one-change PR gets one bullet), in plain sentences a reviewer reads in seconds: what the change does, not how. Details go in Why and Risks. Bare ticket key, no URLs. -->

## Why

<!-- Why this was introduced: the problem, limitation, or previous behaviour. -->

## Diagram

<!-- Mermaid flowchart or sequenceDiagram of the flow or architecture this changes. Delete if the change has no flow. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Viable options considered and why they were not chosen. Delete if none. -->

## Risks

<!-- Compatibility, migration, rollout, operational, or deferred-work risks. Write "None." if none. -->

## API

<!-- Table: endpoint, event or job | runs in | change (added, changed, removed) | code link at the head SHA. A ```diff of the payload only when its shape changes. Delete if no API change. -->

## DB and config

<!-- One ```diff block: tables and columns the migrations add or change, data backfilled or copied, config and env vars added or removed. Delete if none. -->

## Traces

<!-- Changed request path on money or a hot path: the span waterfall of one local run per main path (queries, writes and locks in <details>), one sentence per failure path with its status and reason. Delete if none. -->

## AC and evidence

<!-- The tester verdict table: AC | evidence (test file:name, trace id) | not tested. -->

## After merge

<!-- Docs, runbooks, ADRs or consumer follow-ups to update, and rollout steps. Delete if none. -->
